title: MallWorld house with secret passages
content: Has anyone dreamt about a house they used to live in? But it’s a much larger version of the house with lots of extra rooms and entrances. There’s always a secret passage that leads to a small panic room with a safe in it. The walls of the secret passages are always mattress and cushion like so they’re easy to move. The safe always has something “important” in it but I can never get it open. The extra rooms always have older furniture and decorations that I don’t recall ever owning. And there’s always an incomplete stairwell that I have to parkour to the other side. The bathrooms are always huge with multiple toilet stalls and super tall or super short toilets. Always filthy and never any privacy. Sometimes this house is next to one of my old schools which I’m always late for class. The mall is always nearby too. I used to work at a mall in my teens so it resembles that old mall. Certain stores are fronts for underground night clubs, fighting, or drugs. I have the ability travel around the mall kind of like I’m speed skating but without skates. My phone never works. I find myself trying to call out of work for whatever job I have at the time because I can’t find my way out. And if I find myself a car to drive I always find a road that leads to a bridge that goes straight into the ocean. I have dreams like this on the regular…maybe once a week. If I’m not at a mall I’m at school. Usually high school where I don’t know my schedule and find myself always late for class. Always having to stop off at the weird, disgusting bathrooms. It’s all so strange. I just barely heard about MallWorld. Everyone’s experiences are so trippy.
